newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - March 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - March 10.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on March 10. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
State Secretary Murdiono said maintaining the country's stability would not mean restricting the Indonesian people's rights to channel their aspirations.

Director-general of customs and excise Soehardjo Soebardi had said his department would maintain ship-side trucking of imported goods because it ensured a smooth flow of goods. He said ship-side trucking was to be expanded to cover more goods when the 1995 customs laws came into force on April 1.

Conglomerate Ometraco Corporation has confirmed it has signed a conditional sales and purchase agreement to sell PT Supra Usadhatama to PT Tempo Scan Pacific and PT Indonesian Pharmaceutical Industries for 192 billion rupiah.
